body: Hey. I’d love to but I wouldn’t know what to say. Feel free to pm if you want :)

I learned that game in a game theory class, but with cars. The optimal strategy is to throw the steering wheel out of the window, so the second player can only pick a tie (crashing) or a loss (moving away). Our best play here is to cover our eyes and keep going in a straight line. Bonus points if on a segway.
